Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

The quadrilateral $ABCD$ is shown above. Which of the following is ${A}^{′}{B}^{′}{C}^{′}{D}^{′},$ the image of $ABCD$ under the action of $T?$
worked_solution:
To find the image of $T$ under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing all of the vertices of $ABCD:$

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 4 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 4 & 2 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 & 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 3 & 6 & 8 & 5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective vertices of ${A}^{′}{B}^{′}{C}^{′}{D}^{′}$ are $(-1,3),(0,6),(0,8),(-1,5)$, as shown below.
